## Load the 10X derived sequences :)

```{r loading, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E51.data <- Read10X(filepath_macos)
E51.ADT <- E51.data$`Antibody Capture`
Cells(E51.ADT) %>% length()
# Create Seurat Object using gene expression as main data
E51 = CreateSeuratObject(counts = E51.data$`Gene Expression`, project = "E51", min.cells = 3, min.features = 200)
# Create "Assay" of the Hashtags and Barcode Oligos
E51[["ADT"]] <- CreateAssayObject(E51.data[["Antibody Capture"]][, colnames(x = E51)])

DefaultAssay(E51) <- "RNA"

```

## HTO Hashtag Demultiplex

```{r HTODemultiplex, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
# TotalSeqC Hashtag HTO demultiuplexig
E51.ADT <- t(E51.ADT)
E51.ADT <- as.matrix(E51.ADT)
E51.ADT.Hash <- E51.ADT[, c(4, 6, 8, 10)]
E51.ADT.Hash <- t(E51.ADT.Hash)

E51.ADT.Hash.sparse <- as(E51.ADT.Hash, "sparseMatrix")

E51.ADT.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E51.ADT.Hash.sparse, project = "E51", assay = "ADT")
E51_ADT <- NormalizeData(E51.ADT.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)
E51.demux <- HTODemux(E51_ADT, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.99)

E51.demux <- subset(E51.demux, cells = Cells(E51))

E51@meta.data[["Hashtag"]] <- E51.demux@meta.data[["ADT_maxID"]]


# dCODE HTO demultiuplexig
E51.ADT.dCODE <- E51.ADT[, c(1:3)]

E51.ADT.dCODE <-cbind(E51.ADT.dCODE, total = rowSums(E51.ADT.dCODE))

E51.ADT.dCODE <- subset.matrix(E51.ADT.dCODE, E51.ADT.dCODE[, 4] > 0)
E51.ADT.dCODE <- t(E51.ADT.dCODE[, c(1:3)])

E51.ADT.dCODE.sparse <- as(E51.ADT.dCODE, "sparseMatrix")

E51.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- CreateSeuratObject(counts = E51.ADT.dCODE.sparse, project = "E51", assay = "ADT")
E51.ADT.dCODE.seurat <- NormalizeData(E51.ADT.dCODE.seurat, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 1)

E51.demux.dCODE <- HTODemux(E51.ADT.dCODE.seurat, assay = "ADT", positive.quantile = 0.5)

E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["ADT_classification"]]

E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_CA07", "CA07", E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("CA07_OVA", "CA07", E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])
E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- gsub("OVA_PR8", "OVA", E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]])


E51 <- subset(E51, cells = Cells(E51.demux.dCODE))
E51.demux.dCODE <- subset(E51.demux.dCODE, cells = Cells(E51))

E51@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] <- E51.demux.dCODE@meta.data[["HA_binding"]]

#E51_test <- t(data.frame(E51@assays[["ADT"]]@counts))
#E51_test <- as.data.frame(E51_test)
#E51_test <- E51_test %>% mutate(dCODE_sum = CA07 + PR8 + OVA)
#E51_test <- E51_test %>% mutate(binder = ifelse(dCODE_sum < 11, "None", "Binder"))
#E51@meta.data <- E51@meta.data %>% mutate(HA_binder_2 = ifelse(E51_test == "None", "No Binder", #E51@meta.data[["HA_binding"]]))

#E51@meta.data[["HA_binding"]] == E51@meta.data[["HA_binder_2"]]

#remove(E51.ADT.dCODE, E51.ADT.dCODE.seurat, E51.ADT.dCODE.sparse, E51.ADT.Hash, E51.ADT.Hash.sparse, E51.ADT.seurat, E51.demux, E51.demux.dCODE, E51_ADT, E51.data, E51.ADT)
gc()
```

## Preprocessing of the Gene expression (GEX) data

```{r GEX, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
# Filter out based on feature counts
#VlnPlot(E51, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA"),ncol = 2)
E51 <- subset(E51, subset = nFeature_RNA > 200 & nFeature_RNA < 6500)
#E51

#~~~GENE EXPRESSION~~~
DefaultAssay(E51) <- "RNA"

# Normalize GEX data
E51_GEX <- NormalizeData(E51, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

remove(E51)
# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E51_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E51_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E51_GEX)
E51_GEX <- ScaleData(E51_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E51_GEX <- RunPCA(E51_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E51_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E51_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E51_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E51_GEX, dims = 1:10)
E51_GEX <- FindClusters(E51_GEX, resolution = 0.5)

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E51_GEX <- RunUMAP(E51_GEX, dims = 1:10)

gc()
# Doubletfinder
sweep.E51_GEX <- paramSweep_v3(E51_GEX, PCs = 1:15, sct = T)
sweep.E51_GEX <- summarizeSweep(sweep.E51_GEX, GT = F)
bcmvn_E51_GEX <- find.pK(sweep.E51_GEX)
pk_E51_GEX <- bcmvn_E51_GEX %>% filter(BCmetric == max(BCmetric)) %>% select(pK)
pk_E51_GEX <- as.numeric(as.character(pk_E51_GEX[[1]]))
(ggplot(bcmvn_E51_GEX, aes(pK, BCmetric, group = 1)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + theme_classic())

annotations_E51_GEX <- E51_GEX@meta.data$seurat_clusters
homo.prop_E51_GEX <- modelHomotypic(annotations_E51_GEX)
nExp_poi_E51_GEX <- round(0.08*nrow(E51_GEX@meta.data))
nExp_poi.adj_E51_GEX <- round(nExp_poi_E51_GEX*(1-homo.prop_E51_GEX))

E51_GEX <- doubletFinder_v3(E51_GEX, PCs = 1:15, pN = 0.25, pK = pk_E51_GEX, nExp = nExp_poi_E51_GEX, reuse.pANN = F, sct = T)


E51_GEX <- subset(E51_GEX, cells=rownames(E51_GEX@meta.data)[which(E51_GEX@meta.data$DF.classification == "Singlet")])

saveRDS(E51_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))

remove(sweep.E51_GEX, bcmvn_E51_GEX, Elbow)
gc()
# ~~~ Re-process the data after doublet removal ~~~
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51_GEX_doubletremoval.rds', sep = ""))
plan("multisession", workers = 1)

# Normalize GEX data
E51_GEX <- NormalizeData(E51_GEX, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 10000)

# Find highgly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E51_GEX <- FindVariableFeatures(E51_GEX, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)

# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E51_GEX)
E51_GEX <- ScaleData(E51_GEX, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the GEX
E51_GEX <- RunPCA(E51_GEX, features = VariableFeatures(object = E51_GEX))

# Find dimensionality of GEX dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E51_GEX, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")

# Clustering and...
E51_GEX <- FindNeighbors(E51_GEX, dims = 1:10)
#E51_GEX <- FindClusters(E51_GEX, resolution = seq(0,1,by = 0.05))

# ...Run UMAP with dimensionality based on Elbowplot above
E51_GEX <- RunUMAP(E51_GEX, dims = 1:9)

# Run Clustree to better identify Clusters
clustree(E51_GEX)


E51_GEX <- FindClusters(E51_GEX, resolution = 0.025) #Good resotion for 5 clusters

E51_GEX[["old.idents"]] <- Idents(object = E51_GEX)
DimPlot(E51_GEX)
E51_GEX <- RenameIdents(E51_GEX, '0'='GC B cells', '1' = 'Circulating B cells', '2'="preMBC", '3'="Plasma Blast")

saveRDS(E51_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51_GEX_temp.rds', sep = ""))

DefaultAssay(E51_GEX) <- "RNA"

E51_GEX.markers <- FindAllMarkers(E51_GEX, only.pos = F, min.pct = 0.1, logfc.threshold = 0.2, verbose = F)
top20_E51_GEX <- E51_GEX.markers %>% group_by(cluster) %>% top_n(n = 20, wt = avg_log2FC)
heatmap <- DoHeatmap(E51_GEX, features = top20_E51_GEX$gene, label = T)
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E51_heatmap.svg", sep = ''))

remove(E51_GEX.markers, top20_E51_GEX)

saveRDS(E51_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Continue with the processing of Hashtag/Barcode (ADT) data

```{r ADT, echo=FALSE, include=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=FALSE}
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
DefaultAssay(E51_GEX) <- "ADT"


# Normalize ADT data
E51_ADT <- NormalizeData(E51_GEX, normalization.method = 'CLR', margin = 2)

# Find highly variable features, unsure whether this is even useful here?
E51_ADT <- FindVariableFeatures(E51_ADT, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000)


# scale data
all.genes <- rownames(E51_ADT@assays[["ADT"]])
E51_ADT <- ScaleData(E51_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Run the PCA based on the ADT
E51_ADT <- RunPCA(E51_ADT, features = all.genes)

# Find dimensionality of ADT dataset
Elbow <- ElbowPlot(E51_ADT, ndims = 50, reduction = "pca")
Elbow

E51_ADT <- RunUMAP(E51_ADT, assay = 'ADT', dims = 1:4)
DimPlot(E51_ADT, group.by = "Hashtag")
DimPlot(E51_ADT)
# Clustering and...→
E51_ADT <- FindNeighbors(E51_ADT, dims = 1:5)
#E51_ADT <- FindClusters(E51_ADT, resolution = seq(0, 1 , by = 0.05))

#clustree(E51_ADT)
E51_ADT <- FindClusters(E51_ADT, resolution = 0.01) #Maybe good cluster amount??
E51_ADT <- RenameIdents(E51_ADT, '0'='PBS-CA07', '1' = 'PR8-CA07', '2'='PBS-PBS', '3'='CA07-CA07')


ADT_plot <- DimPlot(E51_ADT, pt.size = 0.2, group.by = "Hashtag") + theme(aspect.ratio=1)
ADT_plot <- ADT_plot + ggtitle('Hashtag/Bardoce clustering')
ADT_plot
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Cluster.svg', sep = ''), ADT_plot)

plot2 <- FeaturePlot(E51_ADT, features = E51_dCODE, pt.size = 0.2, keep.scale = 'all', order = TRUE) & theme(aspect.ratio = 1)
plot2

p3 <- FeaturePlot(E51_ADT, features = E51_group, pt.size = 0.2, order = TRUE) &theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 6), axis.title = element_blank(), axis.text = element_blank())+theme(aspect.ratio=1)
p3

saveRDS(E51_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Merging Seurat with BCR contig using scRepertoire

```{r scRepertoire, echo=FALSE, include=TRUE, eval=TRUE, warning=FALSE}
E51_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Loading Contig file
E51_contigs <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/2_Ig_all_filtered_contigs/mouse_scseq_rep3_contigs.txt", header = TRUE, sep = "\t" )

E51_clonotypes <- E51_contigs

# Renaming MiXCR contig output to match 10X cellranger filtered contig annotations
E51_clonotypes <- E51_clonotypes %>% 
  mutate(chain = E51_clonotypes$chains) %>% 
  mutate(barcode = paste(E51_clonotypes$tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = "")) %>% 
  mutate(reads = E51_clonotypes$readCount) %>% 
  mutate(v_gene = E51_clonotypes$bestVGene) %>% 
  mutate(d_gene = E51_clonotypes$bestDGene) %>% 
  mutate(j_gene = E51_clonotypes$bestJGene) %>% 
  mutate(c_gene = E51_clonotypes$bestCGene)

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR1"] = "fwr1_nt"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR2"] = "fwr2_nt"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR3"] = "fwr3_nt"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqFR4"] = "fwr4_nt"

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1_nt"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2_nt"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "nSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3_nt"

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR1"] = "fwr1"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR2"] = "fwr2"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR3"] = "fwr3"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqFR4"] = "fwr4"

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR1"] = "cdr1"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR2"] = "cdr2"
colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "aaSeqCDR3"] = "cdr3"

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "uniqueUMICount"] = "umis"

colnames(E51_clonotypes)[colnames(E51_clonotypes) == "targetSequences"] = "length"

E51_clonotypes <- E51_clonotypes %>% group_by(barcode) %>% mutate(contig_id=paste(barcode, "_contig_", row_number(), sep = ""))



E51_clono.E51_test <- read.csv(file = "/Users/eliastjarnhage/Library/CloudStorage/OneDrive-UniversitetetiOslo/Documents/Research/10X_files/E51/E51 VDJ_B/filtered_contig_annotations.csv")

#Adding contig BCR information to ADT seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E51_clonotypes, E51_ADT, group.by = "orig.ident")

combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85, removeNA = TRUE)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E51_ADT <- combineExpression(combined, E51_ADT, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E51_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E51_ADT@active.ident)

slot(E51_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E51_ADT, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

saveRDS(E51_ADT, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


#Adding contig BCR information to GEX seurat object
contig.list <- createHTOContigList(E51_clonotypes, E51_GEX, group.by = "orig.ident")


combined <- combineBCR(contig.list, sample = "", threshold = 0.85)
combined[[1]][["barcode"]] <- gsub("_", "", combined[[1]][["barcode"]])

E51_GEX <- combineExpression(combined, E51_GEX, 
                  cloneCall="aa", 
                  group.by = "none", 
                  proportion = FALSE,
                  filterNA = TRUE,
                  cloneTypes=c(Single=1, Small=5, Medium=20, Large=100, Hyperexpanded=500))

# Asigning colors
grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E51_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E51_GEX@active.ident)

slot(E51_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType <- factor(slot(E51_GEX, "meta.data")$cloneType, 
                levels = c("Hyperexpanded (100 < X <= 500)", 
                           "Large (20 < X <= 100)", 
                            "Medium (5 < X <= 20)", 
                            "Small (1 < X <= 5)", 
                            "Single (0 < X <= 1)", NA))

# Highlighting clonotypes
Selected_clones <- c("CARSPLVGGYYYPMDYW_CQQSNQDPWTF", "CTGGGNYFAYW_CQQSYEDPLTF", "CARGGLVYAMDYW_CQQHNEYPWTF", "CARGRYGNTAFAYW_CLQFYEFPLTF", "CARTGNWDGYFDVW_CQQYNSYPLTF", "CARRDRNYFDYW_CQNDHHYPLTF", "CARVGPIYYGYDDYAMDYW_CQQRSSYPLTF")

E51_ADT <- highlightClonotypes(E51_ADT, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
E51_ADT_selected_clones <- DimPlot(E51_ADT, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
                              theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
                              scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

E51_GEX <- highlightClonotypes(E51_GEX, cloneCall = "aa", sequence = Selected_clones)
E51_GEX_selected_clones <- DimPlot(E51_GEX, group.by = "highlight", order = TRUE) + 
                                  theme(aspect.ratio = 1) + 
                                  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Paired", na.value = "grey")

ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E51_ADT_selected_clones.svg", sep = ""), plot = E51_ADT_selected_clones)
ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E51_GEX_selected_clones.svg", sep = ""), plot = E51_GEX_selected_clones)

saveRDS(E51_GEX, file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

```

## Plotting with scRepertoire

```{r ChordDiagram, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10, warning=FALSE}
E51_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))

grid.cols.ADT <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E51_ADT@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.ADT) <- levels(E51_ADT@active.ident)

grid.cols.GEX <- scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(E51_GEX@active.ident)))
names(grid.cols.GEX) <- levels(E51_GEX@active.ident)


# Ova removed E51_testing
E51_ADT.noOVA <- subset(E51_ADT, HA_binding != "OVA")
circles.E51_ADT.noOVA <- getCirclize(E51_ADT.noOVA, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
chord <- circlize::chordDiagram(circles.E51_ADT.noOVA,
                       self.link = 1,
                       directional = 1,
                       symmetric = TRUE,
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on HA bindng
circles.ADT.HA <- getCirclize(E51_ADT, 
                       group.by = "HA_binding")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.HA,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Experimental groups
circles.ADT.ident <- getCirclize(E51_ADT, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.ADT.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)

### Chord diagram over clonal overlap - based on Cell clusters
circles.GEX.ident <- getCirclize(E51_GEX, 
                       group.by = "ident")
circlize::chordDiagram(circles.GEX.ident,
                       self.link = 1, 
                       grid.col = grid.cols.ADT)



### Clonal expansion overlayed on ADT clustering
DimPlot(E51_ADT, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 1) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")), 
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20)) &
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion overlayed on GEX clustering
DimPlot(E51_GEX, group.by = "cloneType", pt.size = 0.5) + 
  scale_colour_manual(values = rev(c("#919191", "#a87391", "#995266", "#c62e2e", "#b2871b")),
                      na.value = "grey") + 
  theme(plot.title = element_blank()) & 
  theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), 
        axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&
  theme(aspect.ratio=1)


### Clonal expansion network overlayed on ADT clustering
clonalNetwork(E51_ADT, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Clonal expansion network overlayed on GEX clustering
clonalNetwork(E51_GEX, 
              reduction = "umap", 
              identity = "ident",
              filter.clones = NULL,
              filter.identity = NULL,
              cloneCall = "strict") & theme(axis.title = element_text(size = 24), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Number of cells binned by clonal expansion by HA binding, GEX cluster, and ADT cluster
p1 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E51_GEX, x.axis = "HA_binding")
p2 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E51_GEX, x.axis = "ident")
p3 <- occupiedscRepertoire(E51_ADT, x.axis = "ident")

(p1 + NoLegend() | p2 + NoLegend() | p3) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.text = element_text(size = 12))&theme(aspect.ratio=1)


combined.ADT <- expression2List(E51_ADT, 
                             split.by = "Hashtag")
combined.GEX <- expression2List(E51_GEX, 
                             split.by = "ident")
### Relative abundance
p1 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.ADT, 
                  cloneCall = "strict", group.by = "Hashtag")
p2 <- clonalHomeostasis(combined.GEX, 
                  cloneCall = "strict")
(p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)

### Occupied Reperoire space
p1 <- clonalProportion(combined.ADT, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
p2 <- clonalProportion(combined.GEX, 
                 cloneCall = "aa")
clonalpropotionplot <- (p1 + NoLegend() | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 16), axis.text = element_text(size = 16), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)
clonalpropotionplot

#ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E51_clonalproportion.svg", sep = ""), plot = clonalpropotionplot)


### CLonal overlap
p1 <- clonalOverlap(combined.ADT, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
p2 <- clonalOverlap(combined.GEX, 
              cloneCall="aa", 
              method="overlap")
(p1 | p2) & theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12), axis.title = element_text(size = 15), axis.text = element_text(size = 15), axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, vjust = 0.8 , hjust = 0.95)) & theme(aspect.ratio=1)
```

## Manual mutation count on nucleotide level

```{r manualMutation, echo=FALSE, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
pattern <- "[SN][ACTGN][0-9]{2,3}[ACTGN]"

E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR1[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR1)] <- 0
E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR2[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR2)] <- 0
E51_contigs$nMutationsFR1[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR1)] <- 0
E51_contigs$nMutationsFR2[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR2)] <- 0
E51_contigs$nMutationsFR3[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR3)] <- 0
E51_contigs$nMutationsFR4[is.na(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR4)] <- 0

E51_contigs$totnMutationsCDR <- str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsCDR2, pattern = pattern)

E51_contigs$totnMutationsFR <-  str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR1, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR2, pattern = pattern) + 
                                str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR3, pattern = pattern) +
                                str_count(E51_contigs$nMutationsFR4, pattern = pattern)


## Mergin Contig mutations with Seurat object:
E51_GEX <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-GEX-Finished.rds', sep = ''))
E51_ADT <- readRDS(file = paste(output_macos, 'E51-ADT-Finished.rds', sep = ''))


E51_mutationList <- E51_contigs
E51_mutationList$Barcode <- E51_contigs$tagValueCELL
E51_mutationList$CDR_mut <- E51_contigs$totnMutationsCDR
E51_mutationList$FWR_mut <- E51_contigs$totnMutationsFR
E51_mutationList <- E51_mutationList %>% mutate(tagValueCELL = paste(tagValueCELL, "-1", sep = ""))

Cells(E51_GEX) %>% length()
unique(E51_mutationList$tagValueCELL) %>% length()

E51_mutationList.HC <- E51_mutationList %>% filter(chains == "IGH")
E51_mutationList.HC.ADT <- E51_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E51_ADT))
#E51_mutationList.HC.ADT$tagValueCELL %>% length()
E51_mutationList.HC.ADT <- arrange(E51_mutationList.HC.ADT, tagValueCELL)
E51_mutationList.HC.GEX <- E51_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E51_GEX))
#E51_mutationList.HC.GEX$tagValueCELL %>% length()
E51_mutationList.HC.GEX <- arrange(E51_mutationList.HC.GEX, tagValueCELL)

E51_mutationList.LC <- E51_mutationList %>% filter(chains == "IGL" | chains == "IGK")
E51_mutationList.LC.ADT <- E51_mutationList.LC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E51_ADT))
E51_mutationList.LC.ADT$tagValueCELL %>% length()

E51_mutationList.LC.GEX <- E51_mutationList.HC %>% filter(tagValueCELL %in% Cells(E51_GEX))
E51_mutationList.LC.GEX$tagValueCELL %>% length()

E51_mutationList.HC$tagValueCELL

E51_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] <- E51_ADT@meta.data[["HC_totMut"]] + E51_ADT@meta.data[["LC_totMut"]]

                                    ifelse(E51_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 9 & E51_ADT@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 20, "11-20",

E51_GEX@meta.data[["MutClass"]] <- ifelse(E51_GEX@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 1 , "0",

                                    ifelse(E51_GEX@meta.data[["totMut"]] > 9 & E51_GEX@meta.data[["totMut"]] < 20, "11-20",
```

## Shazam Calculation

```{r Shazam, echo=FALSE}
# Calculate combined R and S mutation frequencies

# Mutaiton counts - heavy chain
E51_obs_count.HC <- observedMutations(E51_AIRR_HC.subset, 
                                  sequenceColumn="sequence_alignment",
                                  germlineColumn="germline_alignment",
                                  cloneColumn="sequence_id",
                                  regionDefinition=IMGT_V,
                                  frequency=FALSE, 
                                  combine=FALSE,
                                  nproc=8)

# Mutaiton frequenct - heavy chain
E51_obs_freq.HC <- observedMutations(E51_AIRR_HC.subset, 
                                  sequenceColumn="sequence_alignment",
                                  germlineColumn="germline_alignment",
                                  cloneColumn="sequence_id",
                                  regionDefinition=IMGT_V,
                                  frequency=TRUE, 
                                  combine=FALSE,
                                  nproc=8)

# Mutaiton counts - Light chain
E51_obs_count.LC <- observedMutations(E51_AIRR_LC.subset, sequenceColumn="sequence_alignment",
                            germlineColumn="germline_alignment",
                            cloneColumn="sequence_id",
                            regionDefinition=IMGT_V,
                            frequency=FALSE, 
                            combine=FALSE,
                            nproc=8)

# Mutaiton Frequency - Light chain
E51_obs_freq.LC <- observedMutations(E51_AIRR_LC.subset, sequenceColumn="sequence_alignment",
                            germlineColumn="germline_alignment",
                            cloneColumn="sequence_id",
                            regionDefinition=IMGT_V,
                            frequency=TRUE, 
                            combine=FALSE,
                            nproc=8)


# Merging Counts and frequencies to one dataframe for plotting
E51_obs_HC <- E51_obs_count.HC
E51_obs_HC$mu_freq_cdr_r <- E51_obs_freq.HC$mu_freq_cdr_r
E51_obs_HC$mu_freq_cdr_s <- E51_obs_freq.HC$mu_freq_cdr_s
E51_obs_HC$mu_freq_fwr_r <- E51_obs_freq.HC$mu_freq_fwr_r
E51_obs_HC$mu_freq_fwr_s <- E51_obs_freq.HC$mu_freq_fwr_s


E51_obs_LC <- E51_obs_count.LC
E51_obs_LC$mu_freq_cdr_r <- E51_obs_freq.LC$mu_freq_cdr_r
E51_obs_LC$mu_freq_cdr_s <- E51_obs_freq.LC$mu_freq_cdr_s
E51_obs_LC$mu_freq_fwr_r <- E51_obs_freq.LC$mu_freq_fwr_r
E51_obs_LC$mu_freq_fwr_s <- E51_obs_freq.LC$mu_freq_fwr_s
```

```{r}
          lines.width = 35) + scale_fill_gradientn(colours = c("Black","#2d2d2d", "#9fd3bd"), na.value = "white") + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 20.5, color = "White", size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 12.5, color = "White", size = 1.5) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 7.5, color = "White", size = 1.5)

ggsave(filename = paste(output_macos, "E51_phenotype_infection_heatmap.png", sep = ''))


x<- FetchData(E51_GEX, vars = "Ighm", use.scaled = TRUE) 
x <- as.data.frame(x)
head(x)
order.index <- order(x$Ighm, decreasing = FALSE)
cell.order <- rownames(x)[order.index]
head(cell.order)
```
